about: What ceng-m1.2 ported into crates/calc-engine from the pinned legacy source, what it changed and why, what it left out with the beads that will need it (found by the search recorded in owner_search), what it wrote fresh, and each legacy test whose expectation the port keeps, changes or drops (found by the search recorded in witness_search). Only this bead writes this file.

not_ported.beads_basis: Nothing in calc-engine corresponds to the enum or the report: there is one recalculation route and it returns no outcome value. changes.change: The tick is a counter the engine state issues at begin_recalc (1, 2, ...), not minted from the wall clock; a recalculation that fails or is refused after it began has used its tick.
changes.reason: Plan 2.2: computation state is supplied, not read from a hidden clock; a deterministic tick makes the provenance replayable, and portable packages read no clock (std::time panics on wasm32).

changes.change: timestamp_serial and rng_seed are not carried.
changes.reason: No volatile function is in the catalogue this bead evaluates; time and random effect tapes are ceng-m3.6's.

changes.change: The basis identity is calc-doc-model's AuthoredRevision of the input snapshot, a counter, not a 128-bit content digest of the authored records.
changes.reason: The host is the single mutation owner and every authored change advances the revision (plan 3.3), so equal revisions of one document are equal content; hashing an unbounded record set per recalculation is not needed.

changes.change: A snapshot at the state's revision that lacks a formula the state holds is refused (StartError::ForeignInputs).
changes.reason: Two roots at one revision can come from different documents; the engine checks the content it binds from.

fresh: Binding: each unbound pending node's formula text (FormulaText, UTF-16; refused as NotModeled::FormulaText when it holds an unpaired surrogate) is parsed with calc_fml::parse_formula, compiled once with calc_fml::compile in A1 notation against a ReferenceCatalog of the snapshot's sheet names (compared without case by Unicode uppercase; Excel's folding is not measured, and bead dc-85qk measures it), placed with calc_fml::instantiate, and its placed references become prerequisites: a one-cell area a Cell, a rectangle an Area, whole rows or columns an AxisValue, a reference that cannot be placed none; a compile refusal reads nothing and is published as NotModeled::Compile.

Dirty closure over ceng-m1.1's reverse indexes from the pending nodes (each node of a new state, each added or replaced node, each seed's dependents), listed for a caller by EngineState::stale; a new state's nodes are all pending, so the first recalculation calculates every formula, and an added node is pending and bound before the closure is computed.

One numeric mode per published generation: when begin_recalc's mode differs from the published generation's (EngineState::published_mode, set by finish), the closure is every formula node, so no result calculated under one mode is read by a result published under another (plan 3.4).

Deterministic topological ready queue with maintained prerequisite counts; ties broken by the anchor (sheet ID, then row, then column); a closure that cannot be ordered is refused as StartError::Cycle.

The engine's ReferenceReader: literal inputs from the snapshot's pages, a formula cell's value from this recalculation's staged result or the calculated published one; a file cache, a not-modelled result or a scheduled formula not yet evaluated is never handed out (CellRun::Missing; the last fails the recalculation as RecalcFailure::UnscheduledRead).

ReadObserver/Unobserved: step shows the caller's observer each run the engine's reader reports, before the evaluation receives it; the observer gets no reader and no sink and can only stop the recalculation, which then fails as RecalcFailure::ReadFailed (plan 6.5: reads are instrumented apart from publication; plan 2.3: no caller installs its own answer as an engine result).
EngineState::instance: each bound node's placed plan, shared through the state's one PlanCache by normal form; a node is bound once and keeps its instance until its formula is replaced or removed.

Staging and publication: FormulaResult (Calculated with Calculation {revision, tick, mode}; FileCached; NotModeled), ValueDelta and ValueChange; nothing published before finish succeeds; RecalcFailure::ReadFailed, UnscheduledRead, Superseded (a state or snapshot at another revision, or another recalculation published since begin_recalc) and Incomplete publish nothing.

owner_search.rule: Each not_ported item was matched to the Do section of every bead in docs/plan/BEAD_DETAILS.md naming its concept (volatile, RAND/NOW, tick, locale, setting, escalation/broadening, differential, workload/performance, name, external/RTD), and to the beads ceng-m1.1's record assigns for the same concepts.

witness_search.rule: Every #[test] function at the pinned commit (every .rs file of OxCalc at 1bd514ef, by git ls-tree -r) whose own body names, as a whole word, GridSeededLaneOutcome, WorkbookRecalcTick or GridInputSnapshotId (the three symbols the bead's Port from names). A test's body runs from its #[test] attribute's fn line to the brace that closes it. Each .rs file was read with git show 1bd514ef:<path>; files that do not name a symbol anywhere hold no such test. Each found test's assertions were read to give its disposition.
